dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: Listen to me, don't underestimate the sea! I almost lost my life on the last voyage!

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: I was so stoked back then, surveying the sea all day with a scope, trying not to miss anything.

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: Finally, I spotted an uncharted island one day and coaxed the captain into making shore.

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: It was when we got close that we realized it was the backside of a sea monster!

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: We were chased by the awakened monster and had to follow the captain's order to start jettisoning.

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: That included my luggage, all the food aboard, and... the cook.
